body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, suppress one ordinary accuracy bonus on the target until the start of your next turn, up to 1, and reveal its occupied space to allies for that duration.

surges.html: Learn which Defense the target's last attack contested.
On a hit, deal 1 Psychic Damage.

rider.title: Strain - Fracture
rider.html: If you accepted Strain and hit, the target cannot benefit from ordinary concealment against your next Psionics Action until the start of your next turn.
